goal: Implement and prove one bounded platform-plane phase without crossing a plane boundary, a contract, or an approval gate.
done_when: The selected phase file's Done-when list is fully checked with durable evidence.
Every gate in architecture-contract.md section 4 passed on the current tree.

The phase report exists under reports/platform-plane-restructure/ and includes the pre-work baseline, the gate targets fixed before work started, measured results, and every cancelled sub-item with its reason.
loop-state.json, the progress log, and any required ADR are current.
stop_when: A direct dependency phase is not done and has no explicit user waiver.
The work requires a public contract change (OpenAPI, agent-event/v2, capability-contract/v2, SDK behaviour).
A migration against real data, a destructive action, a deploy, an image rebuild of a base family, or a default model change needs approval that has not been given.
The change would violate a hard rule H1-H8 in architecture-contract.md.
The fix requires re-implementing something PRD section 2.5 lists as already fixed, without new line-numbered evidence from the current tree.
The same blocker repeats without new evidence, or max_iterations is reached.
